source: Areas: CIA World Factbook · Statistics Bureau of Japan

beats.say: On world maps it looks like a few small islands. Let's drop it on Europe at true size.
It stretches about three thousand kilometers, from Denmark almost to the bottom of Italy.
Japan covers about three hundred seventy eight thousand square kilometers. Germany, three hundred fifty seven thousand.
But about three quarters of Japan is mountains, so its more than a hundred twenty million people crowd onto the flat coasts.
Small on the map, huge in real life. Follow for more.
beats.title: NOT SO SMALL AFTER ALL
